title: Grateful Dead Live at Crystal Ballroom on 1968-02-03

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard recording cleaned by Charlie Miller captures a stellar early‑68 show highlighted by The Other One suite, New Potato > Caboose, and soaring Eleven→Feedback.
ai_review.review: The upgraded SBD source is remarkably clear, with only faint hiss and a clean mix that lets Jerry’s bluesy leads on “It Hurts Me Too” and the jam‑filled outro shine.  The performance itself is praised for its inventive transitions – especially The Other One with new lyrics, a standout Schoolgirl, and an electrifying Eleven into feedback – making it one of the better shows from this Portland run.

ai_rating.rationale: Over ten detailed 5‑star reviews praise both the musical performance and the high‑quality soundboard mix; only minor criticisms appear, yielding a top‑tier rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Charlie Miller’s cleanup removed most hiss; reviewers note crystal‑clear mix, zero audience noise, and only occasional tape cuts (e.g., Cryptical reprise). Overall the recording is crisp and very listenable.

standout_songs: The Other One (suite with new lyrics)
show_quality.setlist_flow: Strong early set with The Other One segueing into New Potato; the second half builds to a powerful China Cat → Eleven → feedback climax, showcasing tight transitions and inventive jams.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Praised for sick blues leads on "It Hurts Me Too" and overall soaring improvisation throughout the jam sections.
band_member_comments.Phil: Noted for a cool ending on Born Cross‑Eyed; otherwise no specific comments.
